title: Prime Destruction
statement: A multiset of n positive integers (values up to n, n up to 2·10^5) is given. One operation replaces a value x > 1 with p copies of x/p, for a prime p dividing x. The task is to find the minimum number of operations until every element is at most k. The key is a DP over values up to n using the prime divisors from a sieve.
